run.change_description:
feat(completion): support sourcing zsh completion dynamically

Summary:
Previously, you needed to save the completion script to a file and then
source it.  Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh by
running

```zsh
$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
```

Test plan:
1. Run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`
2. Run `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>`

Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1.
After this commit, it should work as expected.

Closes #2956

improve FAQ text for zsh completions

summary.intent: Let zsh users run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` (issue #2956 text supplied in the PR packet) by making the generated script register `_rg` with `compdef` instead of calling `_arguments` outside a completion function, and document it in the FAQ.
summary.issue_fit: Partial — sourcing after `compinit` now works (checked in scratch zsh runs), but sourcing before `compinit` still ends in an error, and the new FAQ snippet does not say so. Intent came from the supplied PR text and commit messages; no forge access.
summary.coverage: Both changed files reviewed against the merge-base diff. Scratch zsh runs outside the clone: source without compinit, source after compinit, source before compinit, and pasting a `$ ` prefixed line. cargo build/test and ci/test-complete were unavailable, so the ci/test-complete path was judged from the `(( ! $+functions[compdef] ))` branch by trace. No risk area touched, so no verification batch was dispatched.

findings.title: Document or handle sourcing before compinit
findings.trigger: A user adds the new FAQ line to `~/.zshrc` above `compinit`, where `compdef` is not yet defined.
findings.impact: The `! $+functions[compdef]` branch runs `_rg`, which fails with `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments` on every shell start, the failure class issue #2956 reported.
findings.change: In `FAQ.md`, state that the `source` line must come after `compinit`, or make the `rg.zsh` tail skip `_rg` when `_arguments` is missing while `ci/test-complete` still works.
findings.source: Issue #2956; commit-7c2a7b0/"Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh".

findings.title: Fix the zshrc snippet prompt and sentence
findings.trigger: A reader pastes the `$ source <(...)` line into `~/.zshrc` as the FAQ says.
findings.impact: The literal `$ ` runs as a command and prints `command not found: $`, so nothing is loaded. The next sentence also reads "is generally slower" with no subject.
findings.change: Drop the `$ ` prefix from the `.zshrc` snippet, and reword to "this approach is easier to set up but is generally slower".

requirements.source: pr-body/"you can dynamically source completions in zsh"
requirements.evidence: crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh:441 works after compinit; a scratch zsh run before compinit fails with `command not found: _arguments`

requirements.source: commit-7c2a7b0/"Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1"
requirements.evidence: Same trace: error removed only when compdef exists
Needs an interactive zsh and a built rg; only the script's registration was exercised
